name: FinSight Daily Brief
_comment_for_claude_code: Hand-authored, not exported from a running n8n instance — node typeVersion numbers (scheduleTrigger 1.2, code 2, httpRequest 4.2) may lag the version you self-host. Import via the n8n UI ('Import from File'); n8n flags/upgrades stale node versions on import. Requires three env vars in n8n's own environment (set via automation/n8n/.env -> docker-compose): SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL, FINSIGHT_API_URL, and optionally FINSIGHT_WATCHLIST. To test without waiting for the cron: open the workflow and click 'Execute Workflow'.
